condition: Peri-operative diabetes — SGLT2 inhibitor, metformin and sulfonylurea before day-case surgery
summary: 57-year-old man with type 2 diabetes on metformin, dapagliflozin and gliclazide (HbA1c 7.5%) listed for day-case laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative planning for groin hernia repair — has diabetes
inputs.hpi: Symptomatic reducible right inguinal hernia listed for day-case laparoscopic (TAPP) repair. Type 2 diabetes for 8 years on metformin, dapagliflozin and gliclazide; no hypoglycaemia; HbA1c 7.5%. No cardiac history. Walks 3 km daily.

exam.general: Well. HR 76, BP 136/84, RR 14, SpO2 98% on air, T 36.6°C. BMI 31.
exam.abdomen: Reducible right inguinal hernia with cough impulse.

mustInclude.note: SGLT2 inhibitors are withheld before surgery (CPOC: the day before and the day of surgery; FDA label: at least 3 days for dapagliflozin) because of euglycaemic ketoacidosis.
Sulfonylurea omitted on the day of surgery (hypoglycaemia while fasting).

mustExclude.note: Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: CPOC guideline — perioperative care for people with diabetes mellitus undergoing elective and emergency surgery
guideline.section: SGLT2 inhibitors: omit the day before and the day of surgery, check ketones; sulfonylureas omitted on the day of surgery; people with diabetes early on the list; capillary glucose monitoring; VRIII when more than one meal will be missed or in emergency surgery; type 1 diabetes: never omit basal insulin (continue long-acting insulin, usually at a reduced dose) alongside VRIII
guideline.citation: Centre for Perioperative Care. Guideline for perioperative care for people with diabetes mellitus undergoing elective and emergency surgery. London: CPOC; 2021 (updated 2022).

guideline.name: FDA labelling change — SGLT2 inhibitors before scheduled surgery
guideline.section: Canagliflozin, dapagliflozin and empagliflozin discontinued at least 3 days, and ertugliflozin at least 4 days, before scheduled surgery (euglycaemic ketoacidosis)
guideline.citation: US Food and Drug Administration. FDA revises labels of SGLT2 inhibitors for diabetes to include warnings about too much acid in the blood and serious urinary tract infections; label update March 2020.

rationale: Base diabetes case: planned day-case surgery on three oral agents. The safety item is withholding the SGLT2 inhibitor (euglycaemic DKA); the quality items are sulfonylurea omission, ketone check and glucose monitoring.
